title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: MiniMax ships official multimodal MCP server — TTS, voice cloning, image, video, music all agent-callable
bullets.summary: MiniMax's just-published MCP server exposes text-to-speech, voice cloning, text/image-to-image, text/image-to-video (Hailuo-02, 6s/10s at 768P/1080P), and music-1.5 as one set of tools any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Cowork) can call.
bullets.how: Drop-in generation backend for Brand 9 Signs creative (signage mockups, social video, voiceover) behind one Construct creative-ops agent; a price/quality alternative alongside our connected Higgsfield server.

bullets.title: Google Gemini Omni Flash (any-to-any video) now in broad rollout across Gemini app, Flow, YouTube Shorts
bullets.summary: Omni generates and conversationally edits high-quality video from any mix of image/audio/video/text with character and scene consistency across edits, SynthID-watermarked, free on YouTube Shorts/Create. Announced I/O 2026; rollout widening now.
bullets.how: For a signage/visual brand, conversational video editing collapses storyboard-to-cut time; wait for the API (coming weeks) before committing The Construct's video pipeline.

bullets.title: Cognition economics validate agentic-ops thesis — $1B at $25B, Devin ships 89% of its own code, ARR $37M to $492M in 12 months
bullets.summary: 13x ARR growth and near-total internal autonomy is the clearest public datapoint that autonomous agents now do the bulk of real production work, not demos. Round closed late May; the operating metrics are the signal.
bullets.how: Direct validation of PRAGMA's AI-operator thesis; the proof-point to cite when positioning The Construct as the agent layer that runs the work, not assists it.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'Effective Strategies for Asynchronous Software Engineering Agents'
bullets.summary: Studies how to run long-horizon background coding agents reliably — task decomposition, async handoffs, recovery — the exact failure modes of fire-and-forget agent runs.
bullets.how: Informs how The Construct schedules and supervises overnight/background agents (Hermes, the daily scans) so async jobs degrade gracefully instead of silently failing.

praxis_lesson: The generation layer — voice, image, video, music — is collapsing into MCP: MiniMax and Higgsfield now expose the entire creative stack as agent-callable tools, and Google is pushing conversational video into mass channels. The Construct's move for Brand 9 Signs is to route creative production through one MCP-backed creative-ops agent (with MiniMax/Higgsfield as swappable backends) rather than paying per-seat for human-driven SaaS — own the orchestration, treat the generators as interchangeable.
